noise_isolation.probe_source_note: Investigation-only patch, absent from production binary. Fixed-replay campaign used the patch subset without initial-dump output; later initial-construction campaign added that output and included restart filename fixes. Probe binary hashes are recorded separately; the final patch reproduces both modes.
findings: Fixed serial pre-BL tensors and final scale agree across MPI below 3.4e-14 with 0/1/10/80 sweep caps.
With identical inputs and no experimental hard-normal BL projection, gradation converges in 32 sweeps to ratio 1.0000000996523131; MPI difference below 6e-13.
With the hard-normal nodal BL projection, ratio remains 2.28272 at 80 sweeps with 17 normal-limited directed edges. This is a separate constraint/policy failure.

Initial sensor metric already differs by 5.46555e-4 / 8.35531e-4 before any corner, BL or gradation processing, despite identical filtered Hessians and sensor normalization integral differences below 8.1e-15 relative.

Inference: nearly rank-deficient filtered Hessians, the 1e14 per-sensor condition cap and generalized-eigenvalue multi-sensor intersection amplify normalization roundoff. Precise stabilization and causal isolation of each operator remain follow-up work.
Keep ADAP_HESSIAN_NOISE=0. No intersection or reduction stabilization was added here; no claim of physical noise filtering suitability.

next_tasks: Stabilize condition-sensitive multi-sensor metric combination without silently discarding finer demands; test nearly rank-one 2D/3D tensors and MPI normalization perturbations.
Improve one-sided curved-wall Hessian recovery and skew sensitivity; preserve separate normal/tangent accuracy gates.
Add symmetry/periodic QR support before real ONERA QR/noise comparison.
Integrate main geometric BL composition, complexity and gradation policy on the main-agent branch, then rebase without replaying superseded experiments.
Validate accepted adaptation cycles and aerodynamic/wall-resolution outcomes; profile memory and work rather than adding a persistent cache speculatively.
